content.prompt: Match up the problems (a to d) with the number lines (A to D).

spec.description: Option A: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, starting dot above 2, and three leftward unit hops ending at −1.
spec.mathematics: Start at 2 and move left three units: 2 + (−3) = −1.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.mathematics: Start at −4 and move left one unit: −4 + (−1) = −5.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.description: Option C: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled 2, 3, 4, 5, starting dot above 4, and one leftward unit hop ending at 3.
spec.mathematics: Start at 4 and move left one unit: 4 + (−1) = 3.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

spec.description: Option D: double-ended horizontal number line, ticks labelled −9, −8, −7, −6, −5, starting dot above −6, and two leftward unit hops ending at −8.
spec.mathematics: Start at −6 and move left two units: −6 + (−2) = −8.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete option diagram is a permanent student-visible given; its matching response is hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}4+(-1)&=4-1\\&=3\end{align*}$$
Start at $4$ and move one unit left to $3$: diagram C.

$$\begin{align*}2+(-3)&=2-3\\&=-1\end{align*}$$
Start at $2$ and move three units left to $-1$: diagram A.

$$\begin{align*}-6+(-2)&=-6-2\\&=-8\end{align*}$$
Start at $-6$ and move two units left to $-8$: diagram D.

$$\begin{align*}-4+(-1)&=-4-1\\&=-5\end{align*}$$
Start at $-4$ and move one unit left to $-5$: diagram B.
